title: snapshot.snapshot_hazard_grid payload
description: M4 § M9 firehose surface. Placeholder payload at M4 (placeholder=true); M9 fills hazard_cells and summary_per_kind. Fires at scenario start and on every objective transition (same cadence as snapshot_terrain_*).

placeholder.description: True when emitted by M4 with a stub payload; M9 producer fills real data and clears this flag.

hazard_cells.description: Per-cell hazard state: { chunk_id, local_pos, kind, intensity, dissipation_rate, spawned_at_tick }.

summary_per_kind.description: BTreeMap<kind, count> roll-up across all hazard cells.
